title: Foothills Golf Club (Phoenix)
specs: Outdoor ceremony site with mountain views
Mountain-side driving range over 300 yards with multiple target areas
Newly remodeled putting and chipping greens over 5,000 sq ft
Children under 18 must be accompanied by an adult at all times in golf simulator area
Proper footwear and attire required for golf simulator use

Facility buyout pricing available for groups over 10

Outdoor veranda event space accommodates up to 225 people

blurb: Guests can play golf on a public course, use practice facilities including a driving range and putting greens, and book golf simulators.
